action.layout_note: piperx has 7 arm/gripper controls; runtime.action_layout is authoritative.

reset.variation: none; seed is provenance only, not a reset randomization input

spec: fixed tool attachment; single rigid pie face A up; pan radius .15, friction .45, pie start XY(.065,0)
50Hz/10s; fixed robot initialization, sampling domains and scoring/contact rules
derived: pie center of mass and inertia from linear in-plane density; COM offset=(1-u)*R/4
pan COM/inertia and tool mounting geometry from handle length/grip fraction/mass
episode_instance: episode_id; same integration initial state for15 episodes; round_plan=null

rules.airborne: optional process milestone: armed, no pan contact>=.04s and lowest-envelope clearance>=.015; save initial separation position/velocity when observed
rules.flip: after armed, the pie's world face-A normal crosses Z<-.5; pan contact is permitted and airborne flight is optional
rules.landed: pan bottom support after the face transition; rim contact alone is not stable support
rules.stable: armed and flipped, bottom contact, radial center distance+pie radius<=pan radius-.003; pan-frame faceA Z<-cos20deg; world pan-normal Z>cos20deg; abs(envelope clearance)<.004; relative linear speed<.08 and angular speed<.5; continuous .5s else timer resets
rules.contact: pie contacts counted at distance<=.0005; non-exempt moving robot/tool collisions only at distance<-.0001; preserve fixed handle/gripper and wheel-floor exemptions
rules.failure: foreign pie contact; non-exempt robot/tool collision; pie worldZ<.15 or norm(pie center in pan)>1.5; nonfinite state invalid in unified evaluation
rules.score: 100 iff success else0; single pie_flipped_and_settled then terminate; milestones do not score; timeout500 steps/10s; last-step success takes precedence
rules.profiles: formal sampling profile_default, not fixed demonstration profile_reference
rules.feasibility: no grasp/tool attachment or ALOHA flip demonstration recertification
